title: Idea graph
description: The structured form of a founder's idea map (EE-060): a Merkle DAG. Each idea's hash covers its text and the hashes of the ideas it builds on, so a change upstream changes every hash downstream. Written by packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map/graph.mjs; it holds no decisions.

source.description: The idea map it was built from, with that file's hash

root.description: Hash over the hashes of the ideas nothing builds on: one value for the whole graph

judged_by.description: Who judged the dependencies: Jev's typed answers, or Naive's convention of which records build on which

depth.description: Longest chain of ideas before it: its column, left to right

edges.description: Typed edges. An edge reads: the idea at to relates to the idea at from by relation. The arrow runs from the idea related to toward the idea whose relation it is, as builds_on always has. Only builds_on edges shape the DAG (hashes, depth, lanes); the others are carried as stated. Every relation an idea states is checked through the EE-095 term engine (term typed-link) before the graph is built

by.description: jev, convention, or stated (a relation the idea records)

dropped.description: Dependencies left out because they would have closed a cycle

mode.description: sync: its ideas build on each other and move in order; async: it moves on its own, beside the other lanes

next.description: The highest-signal ideas that build on nothing: what to develop next
